subject.title: feat: add LLMTR provider for Turkey-hosted and global models

question: Should LLMTR be accepted as a bundled OpenClaw provider, or should it ship and be maintained as an external provider plugin?
rationale: The implementation uses existing extension seams, while the repository vision prefers externally maintained optional plugins and requires a clear reason for bundled promotion.

options.title: Publish as an external plugin
options.body: Move the provider package, its documentation, and release ownership outside the core distribution while retaining the existing SDK-based implementation.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled provider
options.body: Explicitly accept the long-term bundled ownership, then repair the endpoint-class registration and add attribution coverage before merge.

recommendation.title: Publish as an external plugin
recommendation.body: Move the provider package, its documentation, and release ownership outside the core distribution while retaining the existing SDK-based implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a bundled-plugin product and ownership decision rather than a mechanical provider-catalog choice.
